behavior.recorded_worktree_revalidation: The existing verifier checks Git registration, canonical path, branch, repository manifest, Environment definition, checkout identity, and common-directory identity before recovering a nested checkout.
behavior.independent_worktrees: Distinct registered checkout identities remain separate; selected linked-worktree entry and explicit task identity do not adopt another checkout's session.
behavior.duplicate_same_checkout: Multiple live sessions for one selected checkout return campaign-continuation-ambiguous with exact session and checkout identities.
behavior.branch_mismatch: A changed current branch falls through to the existing campaign-checkout-mismatch path.

targeted_tests.command: python3 -m pytest tests/test_entry.py tests/test_selection.py tests/test_claim_generation_cas.py tests/test_controlled_claim_recovery.py -q

verification.new_regression: A fresh CLI entry from the repository root resumed the unique authenticated session attached to a nested registered worktree; a distinct task identity created independent work.

resource_measurement: No separate performance benchmark was run; this change adjusts continuation selection only and does not change compiler build or VM execution paths.
claim_boundary: This proves unique authenticated continuation recovery and preserves selected worktree and claim conflict checks. It does not grant additional repository authority or establish Language verified-fact reuse.
